name: settings
title: Settings
summary: The settings screen of an AI product's workspace: name, URL, logo, time zone and deleting the workspace; API keys with scopes and expiry, the secret shown once, revoke and flags for expired or unused keys; the default model, per-feature models, a monthly spend limit with an alert threshold, rate limits and usage against them; and notification switches per channel with a test send. One save bar holds unsaved changes, with inline validation, optimistic saves that roll back, a leave guard, a read-only viewer state and loading skeletons.
